scope: EXT-D-0111 existing Profile row restoration for EXT-F-1004 admin Identity T06 and Employment T18
diagnosis: The native runner created a durable journal only after it inserted an absent row; an existing admin row therefore sent T06/T18 through the unverified skip branch.
write_shape: Profile Save computes a changed-field patch; Supabase upsert sends user_id, that patch, and the existing row organization_id. The restoration request is a conditional PATCH containing only the nine tested Identity and Employment columns.
repair: The runner privately persists the full existing owner row and exact tested-field baseline before UI writes. A shared versioned intent journal verifies each successor, including structural equality of untouched fields. Cleanup restores only the tested baseline through an owner, organization, created_at, version and current-field conditional PATCH, with no delete authority. New-row conditional deletion remains separate.

evidence.red: Actual existing-row runner branch previously had no journal and recorded preexisting_row_lacks_durable_conditional_full_field_restoration for T06/T18.
evidence.green: Focused node --test suite covers baseline, runner branch, cleanup branch, null Preferred, exact restore, concurrent version, ambiguous successor and original new-row journal; 25 passed.
evidence.request_shape: Verified source sends users Content-Profile and PATCH return=representation, checks exactly one returned owner row, and re-reads the versioned successor.

limits: No native browser, database mutation, full build or release in this source lane. Root owns fresh peer review and native admin acceptance. Sensitive baseline is written only to the mode-0600 private receipt; this report contains no row values.
